title: Queue policy
description: What a destination does when its bounded queue is full (section 10.2 of PR-001, REQ-DLV-007): drop_newest (the default) drops the new event, drop_oldest drops the oldest event of a class not higher than the new one and takes its place, block_with_timeout makes the caller wait for room for at most a mandatory timeout and drops the new event when it ends. Adding a value is a MINOR change of the contract (REQ-VER-003).
